description: This PHP source file implements the Frontbase database driver for the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It defines classes for database connection handling (`ADODB_fbsql`) and recordset manipulation (`ADORecordSet_fbsql`) specifically for interacting with Frontbase via fbsql functions.

classes.name: ADODB_fbsql
classes.description: Handles database connection and metadata operations for Frontbase via fbsql functions.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_fbsql
classes.description: Represents a recordset returned by executing a query, with methods for fetching and navigating records.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves the last auto-increment ID generated in the current database session.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by the last SQL statement.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Returns an array of database names available on the server.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Generates a SQL concatenation expression with provided arguments.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the database server.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Establishes a persistent connection to the database server.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns for a given table.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects a database to use for subsequent queries.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query on the database.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message from database operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error number from database operations.
